prompt:
Image 1 is a style reference only: match its painting style, brushwork, lighting, rim light, framing, background and proportions. The person, the face, the headgear and every ornament must be different from Image 1 and must follow the description below exactly; do not copy the man, the helm, the horns or the trim from Image 1.

Head-and-shoulders portrait bust of one Salamander, a great summoned fire lizard (a creature, not a person), three-quarter view, the face turned toward the right side of the image. Square image. Framing: the top of the head or the horns about 9% from the top edge, the eyes about 39% from the top, the jaw about 62% from the top, the image cut at mid-chest, with dark empty space above and around the head. One creature only, no people, no riders. No claws, limbs or hands in view, no text, no border, no frame, no signature, no logo.
Lighting: a single warm candle key light from the upper left, a dim warm fill, deep warm shadows, and a thin soft warm rim light along the back of the head, the horns and the shoulders that separates the whole silhouette clearly from the background. Background: plain, unpatterned, very dark warm brown close to #1C1A17, with no objects.
Medium: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible brushwork, moderate detail, a strong readable silhouette: the shape of the head and horns and the lit face against the dark background must still read when the image is shrunk to 48 pixels.
Colors: muted and earthy. Nothing in the image glows; there is no fire, no flame, no sparks and no smoke. The only warm color on the creature is a faint, dull ember color in the thin cracks between its scales, and its eyes do not glow. No saturated red, orange, green or blue area larger than a thin crack or a small patch.

Subject: A Salamander, a great fire lizard summoned by Cinder Horde mages: a heavy reptilian head and neck of dark obsidian-black scales with dull ember-orange cracks between them, small horns along the jaw; no open flame, no glow except a faint dull ember color in the cracks.
Creature: a lean old salamander, a narrow wedge-shaped viper-like head, heavy black soot caked in the creases, cracks forming a branching pattern like dried lava; a cold, watchful sidelong look, deep-set dark eyes under a heavy brow ridge. Marks: two long curved horns sweeping back from the rear of the jaw like a ram's, a torn, ragged skin frill along the back of the neck.
